correctness.rationale: The source equilibrium satisfies 1+l d1=Rc. Direct differentiation of the printed vector field therefore gives the stem invasion eigenvalue Ra/Rc-1 and the progenitor invasion eigenvalue gb(Rb/Rc-1). The remaining c-d block has negative trace and positive determinant for Rc>1, with the exact quadratic given in the finding. This yields the if-and-only-if ordinary-model threshold Rc>max{Ra,Rb}. The symbolic checker reconstructs the characteristic factorization and the exact witness.

value.rationale: The boundary equilibrium represents persistence of the myeloid/mature lineage after loss of stem and progenitor cells, a biologically meaningful state explicitly analyzed by the source. Correcting its invasion spectrum changes the local phase diagram: stability requires the myeloid reproduction number to exceed each upstream reproduction number, not an ordering of the two upstream classes. The explicit witness shows that the published eigenvalues can reverse both invasion signs, so this is not a cosmetic simplification.
